claims.statement: The initial slot correction was applied to the wrong carrier feed; the root cause (carrier feed lag on east-node lanes) is confirmed, but the specific feed must be identified for effective mitigation.
claims.corroboration: m8_r_slot_ineff confirms the mitigation was misdirected. m8_r_handoffs provides the mechanism (47-minute lag on east-node pickup confirmations). m8_r_exceptions confirms the cohort routing.
claims.limitation: The feed identification requires direct confirmation with Carrier Operations on which specific east-node feed has the lag.

capability_gaps.capability: Identification of the specific east-node carrier feed with the lag
capability_gaps.reason: The root cause is established (carrier feed lag), but the wrong feed was corrected. Need to confirm with carrier ops which east-node feed is affected to scope the next correction attempt.

next_action.rationale: The slot correction failed because it targeted the wrong feed. With the root cause confirmed as carrier feed lag (specifically a 47-minute booking-to-confirmation lag on east-node lanes), confirming with carrier ops is critical to identify which specific east-node feed(s) experience this lag. This information will enable a correctly-scoped second slot correction attempt.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Specific identification of the affected east-node carrier feed(s), confirmation that they are experiencing the 47-minute lag, and validation that re-correction to the correct feed(s) will resolve the held orders.
